key_insight: ZENO learns a neural operator constrained by the Zakai equation to approximate unnormalized filtering distributions for nonlinear stochastic dynamical systems.
engineering_relevance: The approach supports hidden-state inference and dynamical parameter learning from noisy observations, with potential applications in engineering and neuroscience.
method: Train a neural operator using a Zakai-equation-based physics-informed loss.
Approximate the unnormalized filtering distribution of latent stochastic dynamics.
Use the inferred distribution in expectation-maximization for parameter learning and state inference.
evidence_signal: Evaluation covers simulated Double-Well, Van der Pol, and Lorenz systems with comparisons to established methods, plus recovery of locomotion-related limit cycles from immobilized C. elegans whole-brain imaging.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify computational cost or establish scalability to substantially higher-dimensional latent systems.
paper_title: ZENO: Nonlinear filtering with Zakai Equation Neural Operators
